title: User Interviews × Great Question Integration
summary: Great Question’s integration with User Interviews combines the power of high-quality participant recruitment with end-to-end research workflows. Learn more.
body_markdown: Jack is the Content Marketing Lead at Great Question, the all-in-one UX research platform built for the enterprise. Previously, he led content marketing and strategy as the first hire at two insurtech startups, Breeze and LeverageRx. He lives in Omaha, Nebraska.
